lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲੀ ਰੇ ਜੈ ਚੰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bharame bhoolee re jai cha(n)daa ||
lines.translation: Deluded by doubt, O Jai Chand,

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਹੀ ਨਹੀ ਚੀਨੑਿਆ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: nahee nahee cheenhiaa paramaana(n)daa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: you have not realized the Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਖਾਇਆ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਬਧਾਇਆ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਮੁੰਦਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar ghar khaaiaa pi(n)d badhaaiaa khi(n)thaa mu(n)daa maaiaa ||
lines.translation: You eat in each and every house, fattening your body; you wear the patched coat and the ear-rings of the beggar, for the sake of wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੂਮਿ ਮਸਾਣ ਕੀ ਭਸਮ ਲਗਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bhoom masaan kee bhasam lagaaee gur bin tat na paaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: You apply the ashes of cremation to your body, but without a Guru, you have not found the essence of reality. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇ ਜਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਕਾਇ ਤਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਕਾਇ ਬਿਲੋਵਹੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaai japahu re kaai tapahu re kaai bilovahu paanee ||
lines.translation: Why bother to chant your spells? Why bother to practice austerities? Why bother to churn water?

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜਿਨੑਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh jinhi upaaee so simarahu nirabaanee ||3||
lines.translation: Meditate on the Lord of Nirvaanaa, who has created the 8.4 million species of beings. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇ ਕਮੰਡਲੁ ਕਾਪੜੀਆ ਰੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਕਾਇ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaai kama(n)dal kaapaReeaa re athasath kaai phiraahee ||
lines.translation: Why bother to carry the water-pot, O saffron-robed Yogi? Why bother to visit the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage?

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਦਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਕਣ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਾਹੁ ਕਿ ਪਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: badat trilochan sun re praanee kan bin gaahu k paahee ||4||1||
lines.translation: Says Trilochan, listen, mortal: you have no corn - what are you trying to thresh? ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree ||
lines.translation: Goojaree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਲਛਮੀ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)t kaal jo lachhamee simarai aisee chi(n)taa mahi je marai ||
lines.translation: At the very last moment, one who thinks of wealth, and dies in such thoughts,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਪ ਜੋਨਿ ਵਲਿ ਵਲਿ ਅਉਤਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sarap jon val val autarai ||1||
lines.translation: shall be reincarnated over and over again, in the form of serpents. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਰੀ ਬਾਈ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਤਿ ਬੀਸਰੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aree baaee gobid naam mat beesarai || rahaau ||
lines.translation: O sister, do not forget the Name of the Lord of the Universe. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)t kaal jo isatree simarai aisee chi(n)taa mahi je marai ||
lines.translation: At the very last moment, he who thinks of women, and dies in such thoughts,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਸਵਾ ਜੋਨਿ ਵਲਿ ਵਲਿ ਅਉਤਰੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: besavaa jon val val autarai ||2||
lines.translation: shall be reincarnated over and over again as a prostitute. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਲੜਿਕੇ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)t kaal jo laRike simarai aisee chi(n)taa mahi je marai ||
lines.translation: At the very last moment, one who thinks of his children, and dies in such thoughts,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਕਰ ਜੋਨਿ ਵਲਿ ਵਲਿ ਅਉਤਰੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sookar jon val val autarai ||3||
lines.translation: shall be reincarnated over and over again as a pig. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਮੰਦਰ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)t kaal jo ma(n)dar simarai aisee chi(n)taa mahi je marai ||
lines.translation: At the very last moment, one who thinks of mansions, and dies in such thoughts,

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਜੋਨਿ ਵਲਿ ਵਲਿ ਅਉਤਰੈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: pret jon val val autarai ||4||
lines.translation: shall be reincarnated over and over again as a goblin. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)t kaal naaraain simarai aisee chi(n)taa mahi je marai ||
lines.translation: At the very last moment, one who thinks of the Lord, and dies in such thoughts,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਦਤਿ ਤਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਪੀਤੰਬਰੁ ਵਾ ਕੇ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸੈ ॥੫॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: badat tilochan te nar mukataa peeta(n)bar vaa ke ridai basai ||5||2||
lines.translation: says Trilochan, that man shall be liberated; the Lord shall abide in his heart. ||5||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਜੈਦੇਵ ਜੀਉ ਕਾ ਪਦਾ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree sree jaidev jeeu kaa padaa ghar 4 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Padhay Of Jai Dayv Jee, Fourth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਪੁਰਖਮਨੋਪਿਮੰ ਸਤਿ ਆਦਿ ਭਾਵ ਰਤੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: paramaad purakhamanopima(n) sat aad bhaav rata(n) ||
lines.translation: In the very beginning, was the Primal Lord, unrivalled, the Lover of Truth and other virtues.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤੰ ਪਰਕ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪਰੰ ਜਦਿਚਿੰਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਗਤੰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: paramadabhuta(n) parakrit para(n) jadichi(n)t sarab gata(n) ||1||
lines.translation: He is absolutely wonderful, transcending creation; remembering Him, all are emancipated. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਲ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਮਨੋਰਮੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: keval raam naam manorama(n) ||
lines.translation: Dwell only upon the beauteous Name of the Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਦਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਤਤ ਮਇਅੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bad a(n)mrit tat maia(n) ||
lines.translation: the embodiment of ambrosial nectar and reality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨ ਦਨੋਤਿ ਜਸਮਰਣੇਨ ਜਨਮ ਜਰਾਧਿ ਮਰਣ ਭਇਅੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: na danot jasamaranen janam jaraadh maran bhaia(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, the fear of birth, old age and death will not trouble you. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਛਸਿ ਜਮਾਦਿ ਪਰਾਭਯੰ ਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਵਸਤਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ichhas jamaad paraabhaya(n) jas svasat sukrit krita(n) ||
lines.translation: If you desire to escape the fear of the Messenger of Death, then praise the Lord joyfully, and do good deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਵ ਭੂਤ ਭਾਵ ਸਮਬੵਿਅੰ ਪਰਮੰ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨਮਿਦੰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bhav bhoot bhaav samabyia(n) parama(n) prasa(n)namida(n) ||2||
lines.translation: In the past, present and future, He is always the same; He is the embodiment of supreme bliss. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਭਾਦਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੰ ਜਦਿਬਿਧਿ ਆਚਰਣੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: lobhaad drisat par griha(n) jadibidh aacharana(n) ||
lines.translation: If you seek the path of good conduct, forsake greed, and do not look upon other men's property and women.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਸਕਲ ਦੁਹਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਦੁਰਮਤੀ ਭਜੁ ਚਕ੍ਰਧਰ ਸਰਣੰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: taj sakal duhakrit duramatee bhaj chakradhar sarana(n) ||3||
lines.translation: Renounce all evil actions and evil inclinations, and hurry to the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਨਿਜ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲਾ ਰਿਦ ਕਰਮਣਾ ਬਚਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bhagat nij nihakevalaa rid karamanaa bachasaa ||
lines.translation: Worship the immaculate Lord, in thought, word and deed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੇਨ ਕਿੰ ਜਗੇਨ ਕਿੰ ਦਾਨੇਨ ਕਿੰ ਤਪਸਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jogen ki(n) jagen ki(n) daanen ki(n) tapasaa ||4||
lines.translation: What is the good of practicing Yoga, giving feasts and charity, and practicing penance? ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੇਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਰ ਸਕਲ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਦੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: gobi(n)d gobi(n)det jap nar sakal sidh pada(n) ||
lines.translation: Meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the Universe, O man; He is the source of all the spiritual powers of the Siddhas.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਦੇਵ ਆਇਉ ਤਸ ਸਫੁਟੰ ਭਵ ਭੂਤ ਸਰਬ ਗਤੰ ॥੫॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jaidev aaiu tas saphuta(n) bhav bhoot sarab gata(n) ||5||1||
lines.translation: Jai Dayv has openly come to Him; He is the salvation of all, in the past, present and future. ||5||1||
